verdict.rationale: Stating a basis for advertised approval or success rates is a fair question for an immigration law firm, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Daryanani Law Group publishing any approval or success rate, or any case counts, time window, or methodology behind one. The pages cited cover visa types, attorney supervision, and turnaround language only, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, any advertised approval or success rate comes with a stated basis — case counts, time window, or methodology — on the provider's own pages
